objective: Expose early-warning database capacity monitoring in BUKLOD System Admin without automatic upgrades or touching media/ads.
productionBaselineEvidence: Main BUKLOD Connect Supabase ACTIVE_HEALTHY; server sample returned PostgreSQL slots 43/60, database ~422MB, no waiting locks. CPU/RAM provider metrics not available. Backward-compatible capacity migration live version 20261112013654, authorized admin RPC and nonadmin denial verified; cron active and hourly dedup verified. UI source not yet published via OTA.
chosenApproach: Guard read-only JSON RPC behind database is_system_admin(); private low-frequency hourly snapshot with 60-day retention; isolated Expo Router AdminGate screen linked from first-open Reports drawer. Show only measured values and explicitly null provider utilization, and retain manual provider links.
selectionRationale: Avoid false capacity percentages, added third-party monitoring cost or altering current video/ads. No secrets in client and only one small hourly database sample.
alternativeApproaches: Call Supabase management API from client, rejected because it exposes private provider keys and privileged metrics.
Show CPU/RAM estimates derived from PostgreSQL connections, rejected because they are not real compute utilization.
Buy larger Supabase compute now, rejected without sustained capacity evidence.
acceptanceChecks: Authenticated System Admin receives accurate connection counts, DB bytes, 7-day samples and threshold reasons.
Nonadmin and anonymous requests are denied server-side.
Hourly sampling keeps one row per UTC hour and retains only 60 days.
Unknown provider CPU, RAM and disk quota never show invented percentages.
Screen remains isolated from Community video, advertising, Points and OTA release paths.
preserveBehaviors: Unchanged app-wide navigation, media playback, video memory and ads behavior.
No automatic compute purchases or provider changes.
Existing Supabase uptime workflow remains paused.
Existing public and authenticated RLS policies are unchanged.
Production Android OTA and Expo web bundle remain unchanged until separate validated promotion.
